license_policy.future_dependency_rule: Any future third-party dependency must first receive an explicit entry in tools/supply-chain/licenses.json and an approval record before it may enter go.mod / pnpm-lock.yaml; a discovered dependency without a license record fails the CI gate.

sbom_policy.determinism: same inputs must produce byte-identical output (verified by generating twice in CI)
sbom_policy.committed_artifacts: B001 does not commit generated SBOM artifacts; CI generates, verifies determinism and records SHA-256.

vulnerability_policy.go: official Go vulnerability tooling (govulncheck), exact tool version pinned in tools/toolchain.lock.json tooling section
vulnerability_policy.advisory_data: scanner/advisory database data is intentionally NOT pinned; fresh advisories may fail future CI by design.
